listen_address.description: IP address the exporter binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port the exporter listens on for Prometheus scrapes.

pcmk_socket.description: Path to the local Pacemaker cluster communication socket.

enable_node_health.description: Set to false to disable collection of node health metrics (e.g., node status, uptime).

enable_resource_metrics.description: Set to false to disable collection of resource agent metrics (e.g., running status, fail counts).

enable_cluster_topology.description: Set to false to disable collection of high-level cluster topology metrics (nodes, resources, quorum).

extra_labels.description: Comma-separated key=value pairs (e.g., 'env=prod,region=us-east-1') to attach to all metrics for easier filtering.

pcmk_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for responses from Pacemaker REST API or socket calls.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of simultaneous requests allowed to Pacemaker when fetching data.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting (not recommended in production).

excluded_resources.description: List of Pacemaker resource names to skip when generating metrics.

items.description: Name of a Pacemaker resource to exclude from metrics.
